title: Dualistic Deity on Black Mound
description: A split-composition artwork shows a multi-armed horned deity seated in meditation atop a large black mound. The left side features a light parchment background with purple watercolor splashes and line art, while the right side has a dark background with glowing purple orbs.
prompt: A surreal split-tone illustration of a multi-armed horned deity with golden rings around its neck, seated in lotus position atop a textured black mound. The figure holds various symbolic objects including a staff, chalice, and trident. Left side has off-white parchment texture with purple watercolor splashes and line details, right side is solid black with glowing purple bokeh orbs. Small ritual objects and rings are arranged at the base of the mound. Mystical, symbolic, high contrast ink art style.
